Frontend UI verified: Dashboard tabs with sub-tabs, Announcements Manager, Daily Timeline chart, and Announcement Banner for staff with acknowledgment flow.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Announcements and Daily Timeline features fully tested and working: 1) POST /api/messages creates announcements with title, content, priority (low/normal/high/urgent), requires_acknowledgment. 2) GET /api/announcements lists all announcements. 3) GET /api/announcements/pending returns unacknowledged announcements for current user. 4) GET /api/announcements/unread-count returns count. 5) POST /api/messages/{id}/acknowledge marks announcement as acknowledged. 6) DELETE /api/announcements/{id} deletes announcement. 7) GET /api/tenant/reports/daily-timeline returns hourly availability from 07:00-22:00 with utilization percentages. 8) Frontend Dashboard has consolidated tabs with sub-tabs: Fleet (Live Status, Car Calendars, All Cars Calendar, Manage Vehicles), Reports (Analytics, Fleet Reports, Daily Timeline). 9) Staff users see limited tabs and announcement banner with acknowledge button. 10) Fixed middleware bug where impersonation was not bypassing membership check.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug found in /app/backend/middleware/tenant.py: When super admin impersonated a tenant, the role was downgraded to 'admin' but the middleware still checked for membership. Since super admin doesn't have a membership in the tenant, it returned 403. Fixed by adding 'and not is_impersonating' to the membership check condition.
